reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output shape for a compliant finding.

The cited paragraphs contain no exclusivity, sole-supplier, requirements-purchase, or third-party procurement restriction binding IBM (our party); p0720 is a generic PO-driven purchase obligation, and p0102 limits MSL to 'selected' manufacturing/Services.
p0186 affirmatively contemplates IBM 'migration to a competitive supplier', confirming IBM retains freedom to source elsewhere, consistent with the preferred position.

Restrictions that run against MSL (Nominated/Prohibited Suppliers, IBM Parts) benefit us and are correctly not flagged; volume/forecast commitments are properly deferred to MINCOMMIT to avoid double-flagging.
Deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') passes, and the unchanged text confirms no edit was needed.
